issues.applicant_position: Persecuted for defending young people against an official's brother who sells drugs.
issues.result_quote: the panel is of the opinion that there is no nexus to any of the five Convention grounds set out in section 96 of the IRPA.

issues.issue: Whether the case involves torture under s.97(1)(a) (state agent)
issues.applicant_position: Says the attacker's brother is a government officer.
issues.result_quote: this case does not involve torture under paragraph 97(1)(a) because it does not involve a state agent

issues.issue: Credibility of the claimants' evidence on the threats and complaints
issues.applicant_position: Threats and attacks occurred; complaint documents disappeared after mother moved.
issues.result_quote: this undermines the claimants' credibility in this regard.

issues.issue: Internal flight alternative: risk in Mexico City, Puebla or Guadalajara
issues.applicant_position: Attacker's brother, an official, can locate them in any city.
issues.result_quote: The panel concludes that they did not establish that they would be subjected to a risk to their life

issues.issue: Internal flight alternative: whether relocating is objectively unreasonable
issues.applicant_position: Fears being assaulted again; children have no future in the proposed cities.
issues.result_quote: the panel is also not satisfied that the situation in Mexico is such that it is unreasonable for him and his family to seek refuge there.
